architecture: Observed-only two-output kernel controller blends root and articulated rotation context against the frozen V3 learned trajectory; full FK preserves lengths
baseline: linear root and local quaternion SLERP through complete ancestor hierarchy
selection: Choose expanded learner only if equal-clip combined validation position+0.1rotation improves over frozen V6 and old-validation position/rotation stay within 2%; otherwise retain V6. Freeze complete pair before untouched confirmation.
notes: Eight new training and four validation clips selected from catalog before content download.
Three new confirmation clips are downloaded and read only after selection with both model hashes is frozen.
All original quality gates retained; no deployment on failed gates; no human/Cascadeur comparison implied.
Raw downloads capped at 20MB total, 8MB per file.
training_objective: Cohort-weighted regularized regression of complete curve coefficients fitted from training labels; temporal errors are acceptance metrics, not direct regression loss terms.
experiment: Bounded new-motion coverage with frozen base/controller settings
